name: MarketStructure
summary: An ONNX-based Expert Advisor that uses a machine learning model to classify market structure into 4 categories, then places Fibonacci-based pending limit orders when model confidence exceeds a threshold. It combines ML predictions with a 50-period MA trend filter and employs RR-based trailing stops.
summary_zh: 基于ONNX机器学习模型的EA，将市场结构分类为4个类别，当模型置信度超过阈值时，在斐波那契回撤位挂限价单入场。结合50周期均线趋势过滤，并使用基于风险回报比的移动止损。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是利用ONNX模型对市场结构进行四分类预测（标签0-3），其中标签3和2代表看涨信号，标签1和0代表看跌信号。入场条件要求模型置信度超过阈值（默认0.65），同时价格需与50周期均线方向一致：看涨信号需价格在均线上方，看跌信号需价格在均线下方。入场方式为挂限价单（BuyLimit/SellLimit），入场价基于最近枢轴点之间的斐波那契0.618回撤位，止损设在枢轴低点/高点外加15点缓冲，止盈按2倍风险回报比计算。仓位管理采用固定手数，有最小/最大手数和手数步长校验。移动止损在利润达到0.8RR时激活，将止损移至开仓价加30%浮盈距离处。挂单设有4小时有效期。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy uses an ONNX model to classify market structure into four categories (labels 0-3), where labels 3 and 2 indicate bullish signals and labels 1 and 0 indicate bearish signals. Entry requires model confidence above a configurable threshold (default 0.65) and alignment with the 50-period MA trend: bullish signals need price above the MA, bearish signals need price below. Entries are placed as pending limit orders at the 0.618 Fibonacci retracement of the last pivot high-low range, with stop loss beyond the pivot plus a 15-point buffer and take profit at a 2x risk-reward ratio. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size with validation against broker min/max lot and lot step constraints. A trailing stop activates when profit reaches 0.8RR, moving the stop to the open price plus 30% of the floating profit distance. Pending orders have a 4-hour expiration.

parameters.name: InpMagic
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying positions

pros: 结合机器学习与经典斐波那契回撤策略，逻辑层次分明
有置信度阈值过滤低质量信号，避免盲目入场
挂限价单而非市价单入场，获得更好的入场价格
具有RR基础移动止损和挂单过期机制，风控较完善
新K线检查避免重复信号，防止同根K线多次开仓
pros_en: Combines machine learning with classical Fibonacci retracement for a multi-layered approach
Confidence threshold filters low-quality signals, preventing blind entries
Uses limit orders instead of market orders for better entry prices
RR-based trailing stop and pending order expiration provide solid risk controls
New bar check prevents duplicate signals on the same candle
cons: ONNX模型为黑箱，无法审查训练质量和泛化能力，策略可靠性完全依赖模型质量
InpWindowSize参数已声明但在代码中未使用，存在死代码
枢轴点识别仅回溯100根K线且窗口固定为5，在剧烈行情中可能找不到有效枢轴
移动止损仅锁定30%浮盈，保护力度偏弱，可能在大波动中回吐过多利润
没有点差过滤和滑点保护，在流动性差的环境中挂单可能以不利价格成交
GetLastPivot的窗口判断逻辑中j遍历范围可能越界（i+5超过可用K线数）
cons_en: ONNX model is a black box — strategy reliability depends entirely on model quality with no way to audit training or generalization
InpWindowSize parameter is declared but never used in the code, creating dead code
Pivot identification only looks back 100 bars with a fixed window of 5, may fail to find valid pivots in volatile markets
Trailing stop only locks in 30% of floating profit, which is weak protection and may give back too much in large swings
No spread filter or slippage protection — limit orders may fill at unfavorable prices in low-liquidity environments
GetLastPivot loop may access out-of-range bars when i+5 exceeds available history
improvements: 增加点差过滤和波动率过滤，避免在高点差或低流动性时段交易
将移动止损的锁定比例改为可配置参数，并考虑分步移动策略
修复GetLastPivot中的数组越界风险，加入Bars()边界检查
移除未使用的InpWindowSize参数，或在特征计算中实际使用它
增加对ONNX模型加载失败的更详细日志输出，便于排查问题
improvements_en: Add spread and volatility filters to avoid trading during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
Make the trailing stop lock-in percentage configurable and consider a step-trailing approach
Fix potential array out-of-bounds in GetLastPivot by adding Bars() boundary checks
Remove unused InpWindowSize parameter or actually incorporate it into feature calculation
Add detailed logging for ONNX model load failures to aid troubleshooting

risk_points: ONNX模型为黑箱，模型失效时无任何保护机制
GetLastPivot可能访问越界K线导致返回0值，触发无效挂单
没有点差过滤，高波动时段挂单可能以不利价格成交
仅允许同时持有1个仓位和0个挂单，可能错过连续机会
risk_points_en: ONNX model is a black box with no protection against model degradation or failure
GetLastPivot may access out-of-range bars returning 0, triggering invalid pending orders
No spread filter means limit orders may fill at unfavorable prices during volatile periods
Only 1 open position and 0 pending orders allowed simultaneously, potentially missing consecutive opportunities

summary_en: An ONNX-based Expert Advisor that uses a machine learning model to classify market structure into 4 categories, then places Fibonacci-based pending limit orders when model confidence exceeds a threshold. It combines ML predictions with a 50-period MA trend filter and employs RR-based trailing stops.
